core.verify.note: client-core's verifier, which the Node runner drives vector for vector.

core.cache.note: The browser adapter is online-only with no verified cache; on desktop the host's Node SDK holds it. No work package gives the browser one.

core.bundle.note: client-core's inspectBundle exists; the React SDK does not expose an import.

core.local.note: No local-only client in React; P1b-07 leaves it unowned.

core.store.note: On desktop the host process's store holds the token.

license.enroll.note: On desktop the host's Node SDK enrols.

license.reregister.note: New web N/A (P1b-01). On desktop the host's Node SDK re-registers (P1b-06).

config.secret.note: The desktop renderer never holds secrets either; the host reads them with the Node SDK.

config.mint.note: P1b-08 ports edge-mint to Node, Python and Swift only.

config.mirror.note: The TypeScript mirror is rendered by tools/gen-mirrors.ts.

devices.fingerprint.note: On desktop the host's Node SDK computes it.

devices.facts.note: On desktop the host's Node SDK collects them.

devices.register.note: New web N/A (P1b-01). On desktop the host's Node SDK registers.

devices.manage.note:
New web N/A (P1b-01). Through the desktop bridge only. A browser cookie session cannot call /

/devices, which authenticates with a device bearer; the browser adapter refuses with device-management-unsupported.

devices.report.note:
New web N/A (P1b-01). P1b-07 adds desktop reporting through the bridge. POST /

/devices/report accepts only a device bearer, which a browser does not hold.

identity.devicecode.note: New web N/A (P1b-01). Through the desktop bridge (beginSignIn/pollSignIn). A browser signs in with the OIDC redirect (identity.oidc).

update.driver.note: No updater hand-off in React, and no work package adds one.

update.bootguard.note: P1-09 pins the guard rows in stage-matrix.json, but only P3-10 (Godot) implements them.

packs.apply.delta.note: The WASM decoder in P4-06; dcz in Chromium in P4-18.

packs.transport.steam.note: On desktop the host's Node SDK owns platform transports.

packs.transport.msix.note: On desktop the host's Node SDK owns platform transports.

packs.transport.flatpak.note: On desktop the host's Node SDK owns platform transports.

ui.stages.note: Partial today: the loading phase and LicenseGate screens, with no stage machine.

commerce.receipt.note: P6-01 builds the Worker bridge and leaves the SDK side planned with no owner.
